rca_of_issue: P0 login 'stays on /admin-pin-login' RCA: the earlier Playwright script targeted the 'Sign in' text node rather than the Pressable that owns onPress={submit}. RN-Web renders the Pressable as a <div role="button"> and the child <Text>Sign in</Text> as a separate node; clicking the Text node does not bubble to a synthetic onPress event on RN-Web (only clicks on the outer Pressable/role=button fire onPress). Fix for future automation: always target the [data-testid="admin-pin-submit"] Pressable, not the label. No application-side regression — real users clicking the visible button work fine (hit-testing on real pointer input dispatches from the outer Pressable).
